rules.rationale: This exact empty-#loop transition is LOOP-SPEC.loop-empty in loop-spec.k lines 6-37. prove.sh lines 27-34 first compiles VERIFICATION-LOOPS, which does not contain the rule, and proves that claim; verification.k is compiled only later at lines 44-47. The installed priority(40) attribute controls deployment order but does not change the proved transition.

This exact nonempty-#loop transition, including numericVal/numericSeq guards and every state-cell update, is LOOP-SPEC.loop-cons in loop-spec.k lines 39-71. prove.sh lines 27-34 proves it against VERIFICATION-LOOPS before the rule-bearing VERIFICATION module is compiled at lines 44-47.

This exact empty-For transition is LOOP-SPEC.for-empty in loop-spec.k lines 73-104. prove.sh lines 37-41 proves it against the bridge-free VERIFICATION-LOOPS definition, composing only the loop claims that lines 31-34 already proved, and does so before compiling verification.k.

This exact nonempty-For transition, including its numeric sequence guard and complete state transformation, is LOOP-SPEC.for-cons in loop-spec.k lines 106-138. prove.sh lines 37-41 proves it using the bridge-free definition and the previously proved loop claims, before the corresponding reusable rule is introduced by the compilation at lines 44-47.
